name: Ray Casting
aliases: Ray Casting (in context of volume rendering primary rays)
Ray Casting — Primary Ray Tracing, Ray Casting (in context of volume rendering primary rays), Ray tracing of volume data (historical term)
Ray tracing of volume data (historical term)
definition: The basic form of ray tracing considering only primary (or viewing) rays, without secondary rays for shadows, reflections, or refractions.
summary: Ray casting determines pixel color by casting primary rays to find the first intersection with geometry, excluding secondary rays for shadows or reflections.
